dek: The Housing Bureau (HB) released today (August 13) that the latest quarterly Composite Waiting Time for Subsidised Rental Housing (CWT) is 4.8 years, a slight increase of 0.1 years as compared with the last quarter, which remains lower than the records between 2018 and 2025, and continues to maintain below 5.0 years.
